title: ci(workflows): fix anyio and google-genai dependency conflict in requirements.txt and CI workflows (riteshbonthalakoti/HELPDESK.AI)

ci(workflows): fix anyio and google-genai dependency conflict in requirements.txt and CI workflows — open-source issue in riteshbonthalakoti/HELPDESK.AI. Labels: help wanted, Status: Assigned, type:devops, wocs, level 2, wsoc. ### 📋 Problem Statement
Scheduled CI workflows (`key-rotation.yml` and `auto-close-tickets.yml`) fail with `ERROR: ResolutionImpossible` because `fastapi==0.104.0` requires `anyio<4.0.0` while `google-genai==2.8.0` requires `anyio>=4.8.0`. In addition, `auto-close-tickets.yml` fails with `SupabaseException: supabase_url is required` due to missing secrets/env variables.
